messages:
ana_ml: brought up mosaic-13B-q2b across H100/A100 in us-east1/us-west1/eu-west1. did a continuous-batcher sweep (batch_window = [8,16,32,64] ms, max_batch_tokens = [512,1024,2048]). quick summary: H100 p50 ~36-45ms, p95 ~110-150ms, throughput ~160->120 tok/s as window increases; A100 p50 ~48-70ms, p95 ~220-400ms, throughput ~90->60 tok/s. fairness tilt 0.7 knocks throughput ~10-13% but tightens tails. no obvious >1% quality regression on eval-suite v3 yet.

ana_ml: command we used (for reproducibility):
```bash
./bench --model mosaic-13B-q2b --quant q2b --device h100 --region us-east1 --batch-window 32ms --max-tokens 1024 --samples 1000 --continuous-batcher --kernels fused-attn,triton
```

benchbot: results uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/eng-ml/mosaic13b/q2b/1818003456/ (csv + latency/throughput plots + per-run metadata) :white_check_mark:

devon_infra: nice. can you list the kernel variants per device and whether prefix/KV cache was on for the runs?

ana_ml: for H100 we used fused-attn (custom fused kernels) + triton fallback; for A100 we used tiled attn + rilu-tiling fallback. prefix/KV cache = enabled for ~95% of runs (we did warmup sequences for all runs).

samir_perf: curious about eval deltas — did q2b cause any NLG/NLI regression vs fp16? even small shifts matter for the regression alerts.

maria_eval: ran eval-suite v3 (1k prompts, mixed regen + long-context). small EM drop ~0.8% concentrated on long-context QA and some multi-turn coref cases. attaching diffs, will upload annotated failures.

devon_infra: can you translate this into rough capacity sizing for a dedicated pool targeting p50<=60ms at 1024 tokens? rough numbers ok.

ana_ml: rough thumb: H100 pool with 8 cards can sustain ~18-20 concurrent steady streams at p50<=60ms (1024 max tokens). A100 needs ~14 cards to hit similar p50 but tails worse; to maintain p95<=200ms you'd want ~12% extra headroom. i'll put calibrated numbers in a doc.

jess_platform: good. can we add the batching knobs + fairness tilt into Redwood Optimize suggestions? also flag this run for canary configs.

maria_eval: uploaded diffs + failure examples: https://rwd-internal/bench/mosaic13b/q2b/diffs_1818003456.csv — most failures are long-context extraction. nothing catastrophic but worth noting.

samir_perf: let's run an A/B with traffic mirroring: q2b vs fp16 on a subset to measure real-world metric drift. also test lower tilt (0.5) to see throughput/latency sweet spot.

ana_ml: opened PR with bench harness + results + per-region CSVs. PR: internal/bench/1818003456. @benchbot please tag the runs with metadata labels.

benchbot: tagged run 1818003456 with labels: [model:mosaic-13B, quant:q2b, regions:us-east1|us-west1|eu-west1, devices:H100|A100, cont_batch_sweep:true, sample_count:1000]

devon_infra: :thumbsup: let's follow up with a short doc (capacity + recommended kernel profiles + optimizer knobs). ana, can you add a small section on warmup patterns (kv prefix warmup) so platform can automate warmup for private deployments?

ana_ml: will do, adding warmup recommendations + kernel hints to the doc and linking results. thanks all.
